units.source_text: 他怀里紧紧抱着大瓶，那小腿怎么像借来似的，好容易支撑住了重心，他踉踉跄跄地走回了屋子。

en.t: He held the large bottle tightly against his chest, and his thin legs looked almost as if they had been borrowed; barely managing to keep his balance, he staggered back into the room.

units.source_text: 头顶上，牢牢嵌着晕眩之箍，他想朝女人那边看一眼，可无论如何也无法正面瞧她。

en.t: Above his head, a tight hoop of dizziness seemed fixed in place. He wanted to glance toward the woman, but no matter what he did, he could not look at her straight on.

units.source_text: 单眼的眼角，歪斜地捕捉到女人的脸，看上去十分窄小。

en.t: Out of the corner of one eye, he caught the woman's face at a slant, and it looked terribly narrow and small.
